deck_title: Mercator-Gudermann conformal Tissot indicatrix vs naive Plate Carree UV rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Gerardus Mercator (1569) & Christoph Gudermann (1830) inverse Gudermannian conformal projection y = gd^-1(phi) = ln(sec phi + tan phi) matching meridional scale factor dy/dphi = sec phi = 1 + u to parallel secant scale k_p = sec phi to lock Tissot indicatrix aspect ratio at 1.0000x across all 17 stations (u in [0.000, 1.000], phi in [0 deg, 60 deg], 0/17 violated) versus naive equirectangular Plate Carree UV mapping (y = phi, k_m = 1, which stretches circular craters and vortex decals horizontally as 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-step Simpson meridional quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Planetary crater, hurricane vortex, and Voronoi cellular noise decals that must stay circular rather than stretching 2x horizontally at 60 deg latitude
Rhumb-line (loxodrome) navigation charts and spherical environment projections requiring exact local angle preservation (k_meridian = k_parallel = sec phi)
Real-time WebGL/Canvas vertex & fragment shaders needing closed-form Gudermannian UV mapping without 64-step meridional quadrature
not_for: Global area-budget or radiometric irradiance integration across the whole sphere (use Archimedes cylindrical equal-area z = sin phi instead)
Polar caps at phi -> 90 deg where Mercator coordinate y = ln(sec phi + tan phi) diverges logarithmically
Static 2D flat UI buttons without spherical coordinates
